after_start.name: Me
after_start.text: *After school. I decide to look around the campus. I still don't know the layout.*

after_start_2.name: Me
after_start_2.text: *I walk down the hallway. My phone buzzes. — The group chat from my old school.*

after_kakao_1.name: Me
after_kakao_1.text: *'Sojeong posted cherry blossom photos with her boyfriend lol'*

after_kakao_2.name: Me
after_kakao_2.text: *I put my phone back in my pocket.*

after_kakao_4.name: Me
after_kakao_4.text: *I'm fine. Really. It's already in the past. I never even confessed and it just ended. It's not lingering feelings — it's regret. — What if I had said something back then? Even if I'd been rejected, at least I wouldn't feel this unsettled.*

after_kakao_5.name: Me
after_kakao_5.text: *At this school — I'll say what I want to say. This time.*

after_kakao_end.name: Me
after_kakao_end.text: *I take out my phone again and leave the group chat. Done. — I belong to this school now.*

after_miss_dain_1.name: Me
after_miss_dain_1.text: *Walking down the hallway when I hear heavy footsteps behind me.*

after_miss_dain_3.name: Me
after_miss_dain_3.text: *I dodge to the side reflexively. Dain zooms past me. Running, then a sudden stop.*

after_miss_dain_5.name: Me
after_miss_dain_5.text: Why are you sprinting in the hallway?

after_miss_dain_6.name: Dain
after_miss_dain_6.text: I'm late! Gotta get to the gym! — Oh, see you tomorrow! Transfer kid!

after_miss_dain_7.name: Me
after_miss_dain_7.text: *She waves and runs off. Like a storm. We haven't even properly introduced ourselves and she's already this casual.*

after_miss_yuna_1.name: Me
after_miss_yuna_1.text: *Passing by the library when I notice a girl with red eyes walking while reading a book. The tattoos on her arms stand out — but the way she holds the book is surprisingly quiet.*

after_miss_yuna_4.name: Me
after_miss_yuna_4.text: *And she walks on. That's it. But — something about her stays in my mind.*

after_miss_seoyeon_1.name: Me
after_miss_seoyeon_1.text: *On my way out, I run into Seoyeon in the hallway.*

after_miss_seoyeon_4.name: Seoyeon
after_miss_seoyeon_4.text: Lunch. I left the rooftop open. Making me wait — bold move for a transfer student.

after_miss_seoyeon_6.name: Seoyeon
after_miss_seoyeon_6.text: ...I went up for some air and the door happened to be open.

after_miss_seoyeon_7.name: Me
after_miss_seoyeon_7.text: *She definitely waited. — I feel a little sorry, and oddly, a little amused.*

after_hidden_homeroom_1.name: Me
after_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *I'm about to head home when — a voice from behind.*

after_hidden_homeroom_3.name: Me
after_hidden_homeroom_3.text: *It's the homeroom teacher. Her cardigan is even more disheveled than before. Looks like the day took a toll on her.*

after_hidden_homeroom_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_4.text: You're not in trouble. — You're the transfer student, so. How are you settling in?

after_hidden_homeroom_choice.name: Me
after_hidden_homeroom_choice.text: *Sounds like a routine check-in, but her eyes are genuinely watching me.*
choices: I'm fine. It's a nice school, actually.

after_homeroom_ok.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok.text: Good to hear. — If anything comes up, stop by the faculty office. That's what I'm here for.

after_homeroom_ok_2.name: Me
after_homeroom_ok_2.text: *Thought he was the distant type, but he actually looks out for people. — Or maybe it's just part of the job.*

after_homeroom_honest_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_1.text: Feeling overwhelmed is normal. It'd be weirder if you were chill on your first day at a new school.

after_homeroom_honest_2.name: Me
after_homeroom_honest_2.text: Have you ever transferred schools, sir?

after_homeroom_honest_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_3.text: ...Something like that. I've been thrown into a new place out of nowhere before.

after_homeroom_honest_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_4.text: If it gets too rough, come to the faculty office. I can get you a coffee — wait, you're a student. Juice, then.

after_homeroom_honest_5.name: Me
after_homeroom_honest_5.text: A teacher buying a student drinks?

after_homeroom_honest_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_6.text: Professional concern. — I really shouldn't be doing this, but hey.

after_homeroom_honest_9.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_9.text: If you can't settle in, I'll come drag you back.

after_homeroom_honest_10.name: Me
after_homeroom_honest_10.text: *She disappears down the hallway. Her long hair sways. — "I really shouldn't be doing this" seems to be her catchphrase.*

after_homeroom_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_freetalk.text: *Chatting with the homeroom teacher in the hallway.*
after_homeroom_freetalk.context: Day 1 after school. The homeroom teacher stopped the transfer student to check on them. The student was honest about feeling overwhelmed. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
after_homeroom_freetalk.personality: The homeroom teacher hides warmth behind dry humor. Early 30s female teacher with brown wavy long hair and beige cardigan, deadpan delivery. Her catchphrase is "I really shouldn't be doing this." Former aspiring novelist.

after_hidden_nurse_intro.name: Me
after_hidden_nurse_intro.text: *Walking down the hallway when — my head gets a little dizzy. First-day nerves, probably.*

after_hidden_nurse_intro_2.name: Me
after_hidden_nurse_intro_2.text: *There's a sign for the nurse's office on the wall. — Should I go in?*

after_hidden_nurse_choice.name: Me
after_hidden_nurse_choice.text: *I've been meeting people nonstop since this morning.*

after_nurse_skip.name: Me
after_nurse_skip.text: *I decide to just head home. It's probably nothing.*

after_nurse_enter_1.name: Me
after_nurse_enter_1.text: *I open the nurse's office door. A faint smell of antiseptic. White curtains, a white bed, a small desk. A woman is sitting at the desk. White coat, a stethoscope around her neck. Long brown hair loosely tied back, watching me over her glasses with her chin propped on one hand. She was reading something — and looks up.*

after_nurse_enter_4.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_4.text: Transfer student? In the nurse's office on day one — you must be drained. What's bothering you?

after_nurse_enter_5.name: Me
after_nurse_enter_5.text: *The nurse walks over. Her hand lands on my forehead.*

after_nurse_enter_6.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_6.text: No fever~... Might be low blood pressure though.

after_nurse_enter_7.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_7.text: No fever, but... you need to relax a bit. Here, lie down. Just ten minutes.

after_nurse_enter_8.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_8.text: You don't have to be formal here. The nurse's office is a chill zone. — That's kind of the whole point.

after_nurse_enter_9.name: Me
after_nurse_enter_9.text: *I sip some water and look around. A small potted plant in the corner.*

after_nurse_enter_10.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_10.text: Rosemary. — Been growing it since my hospital days. Ancient history~ I like it here. Everyone only comes in with minor scrapes.

after_nurse_enter_11.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11.text: Come by anytime~ The door's always open. But don't come too often. You'll make me worry.

after_nurse_enter_12.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_12.text: Next time you feel sick — ah, well, better if there's no next time.

after_nurse_freetalk.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_freetalk.text: *Chatting with the school nurse in the nurse's office.*
after_nurse_freetalk.context: Day 1 after school. The transfer student felt dizzy and visited the nurse's office. The nurse was playful but attentive. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
after_nurse_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is playful and flirtatious but hides genuine feelings behind jokes. Former hospital nurse who burned out. "Because I'm a teacher" is her shield — there's always a hidden emotion behind it.

after1_jealousy_seo_1.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_1.text: Hey, where'd you go during lunch? I went to the snack bar but you weren't there.

after1_jealousy_seo_2.name: Me
after1_jealousy_seo_2.text: *...What should I say. If I mention I was with Seoyeon, things might get weird.*

after1_jealousy_seo_3.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_3.text: ...The rooftop? Just the two of you?

after1_jealousy_seo_choice.name: Me
choices: I ate on the rooftop with the president. (Honest)
I was just wandering around alone. (Lie)

after1_jealousy_seo_honest.name: Me
after1_jealousy_seo_honest.text: Yeah, she brought me there. Even had a packed lunch for two.

after1_jealousy_seo_honest_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_honest_2.text: ...I see? Could've told me, at least.

after1_jealousy_seo_lie.name: Me
after1_jealousy_seo_lie.text: Nah, I was just wandering around by myself.

after1_jealousy_seo_lie_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_lie_2.text: Really? Alone? — Well, makes sense, it's your first day!

after1_jealousy_seo_yuna.name: Me
after1_jealousy_seo_yuna.text: *A folded note falls out of my pocket. Yuna's handwriting.*

after1_jealousy_seo_yuna_2.name: Me
after1_jealousy_seo_yuna_2.text: *'I saw you on the rooftop at lunch. ...You looked close with the student council president.' — Three dots at the end. Words swallowed.*

after1_jealousy_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
after1_jealousy_dain_1.text: I saw you at the snack bar with Dain during lunch. You adapt fast.

after1_jealousy_dain_2.name: Me
after1_jealousy_dain_2.text: *She's smiling. But her eyes aren't. Her fingers are tapping the clipboard.*

after1_jealousy_yuna_1.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_yuna_1.text: You went to the library at lunch? With Yuna?

after1_jealousy_yuna_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_yuna_2.text: ...She doesn't usually hang out with anyone, you know.
